notes.title: Hotfix v0.2.1
notes.notes:
BUGFIX
- Depending on where your cursor is, it's possible to stack multiple items onto the same item storage space. This has now been fixed.

CHANGES
- All the number sticker items (big sticker, zero sticker, four sticker etc) have been buffed to gain +5 Points instead of +3 Points whenever a die rolls their associated number.

notes.title: Patch v0.2.0 - New Cats!
notes.notes:
NEW CATS!!
Fancy George : whenever a dice triggers its dice effect, give +3 Mult.

The Collector : +2 Mult for each item, including those on other cats.

Meditating Cat : + Mult equal to current round.

Confused Cat : if you have more Points than Mult, set Points equal to Mult and x2 Points.

Space Cadet : +30 Points for each empty dice slot and each empty position without a cat.

Mime Cat : copies the effect of the first Item-slot.

Lykoi : x1 Mult. For each dice placed that has a different value to the dice placed here, +1/2 to multiplier.

Shopkeeper : permanently gain +1 Mult whenever you buy an item. (New Steam achievement: unlocked by storing either a cat or item in the shop)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144288/8271c2a39401bd4af51aca4144d3a341ffebdcba.png"]


Bug-fix
- Quest reminder now appear consistently. Previously, the reminder will only appear for certain quests.


Changes
- The Blank Cat now has 0 on all its dice faces to better complement its passive ability.


Quality-of-life
- The bonuses you currently have will remain on the scoreboard instead of disappearing after pressing 'Play'. The bonus text used to extend beyond the scoreboard if you have too many of them active at once, this has now been fixed by breaking them up into two separate lines.

- Tooltips now appear when you hover over a cat or item storage space.



This update is also coming with a 20% discount, so if you are interested but have yet to buy the game, consider giving it a try. And finally, to all players who have already bought Cats & Dice, thank you for the support! I know I'm not the fastest when it comes to updates, but they are coming and there will be more ahead :)



Cheers,

Yong

notes.title: HOTFIX - Patch v0.1.0
notes.notes:
This hotfix is to address a couple of bugs in the latest update.

- In HARD mode, the score requirement jumps from 65,000 for round 12 to 950,000 for round 13, before going back down to 136,000 for round 14. This is obviously a mistake on my part. The score requirement for round 13 is supposed to be 95,000 with 1 less zero. This has been fixed.

- The shop can possibly roll a cat that you already have (but only for the cat placed in storage). This is unintended and has now been fixed.

notes.title: Patch v0.1.0 - New Storage System!
notes.notes:
Changes
- The score requirements across all difficulties have been reduced to make for a smoother difficulty curve. This means players should have more time to get a build going before the score needed really starts to ramp up. Endless mode however still maintains a very steep increase in score.



- Stacked Chips has been changed to "Dice get +7 Points for each SPADE or HEART when scored." Originally it gives +7 Points no matter how many stacks of SPADE or HEART you have.


Quality-of-life
- If you take on any quest that affects you during a round (such as by limiting your number of rerolls or plays), a quest button will appear to remind you of what quest you've taken.


Misc
- Adjusted the positioning of some tooltips.

- Changes in some of the cats' names for the Chinese language.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144288/a62d062fc6133fd6c047ccafddcbfb1e9e4d4db8.gif"]


NEW FEATURES


- The shop now has a storage system where you can keep a cat or items you might not immediately want to bring into the next round. It's also a quality-of-life addition for when you want to buy/sell a cat without having to temporarily move items around onto other cats, or worse yet, sell those items away because there are no space left to place them.



- 2 new items have also been added:

Bright Gem (common): increase the Points value of BLING by +15.

Slingshot (uncommon): swap the dice placed here with the dice on the adjacent right, if any.





Most of my development time since release has gone into bug-fixing and the new storage system. Subsequent updates will be bringing more new cats and items!

notes.title: HOTFIX
notes.notes:
This is still patch v0.0.7.

BUG FIXES

Apologies. While fixing the Stone Cube and Spectral Pendant bug for yesterday's patch, I unintentionally introduced a new bug that affected items that could grow, such as the Nanobot and Dumbbell. This bug should be fixed now. If you notice any odd behavior with the aforementioned items, please let me know. Thank you.

notes.title: HOTFIX - Patch v0.0.7
notes.notes:
BUG FIXES

- Any cat that has the Stone Cube or the Spectral Pendant equipped will continue to have a Stone or Spectral dice even after those items have been removed. This has now been fixed.

- The Bookie will now correctly double your $ gain when you accept the quest to skip the current round and double your current $.

notes.title: Patch v0.0.6
notes.notes:
There's some significant changes made on this patch.

CHANGES

Score Progession
The score needed for the first few rounds have been slightly lowered to give players more leeway in the beginning to account for bad luck.

Normal mode: Round 2: 800 --> 700 | Round 3: 1400 --> 1200 | Round 4: 2400 --> 2200
Hard mode:   Round 2: 800 --> 700 | Round 3: 1450 --> 1200 | Round 4: 2450 --> 2200 | Round 5: 4100 --> 4000
Brutal mode: Round 2: 850 --> 750 | Round 3: 1500 --> 1300 | Round 4: 2500 --> 2400

Siamese Twins
The way it currently works, the Siamese Twins makes the Yinyang Cat looks downright silly in comparison. Siamese has been changed so that its effect can no longer be affected by buffs such as the Shieldmaiden.

Old: All dice with a value of TWO will be scored [1] additional time. (the [1] can be buffed)
New: Change the value of the dice placed here to TWO. All dice with a value of TWO will be scored two additional times.

To compensate for the nerf, the Siamese Twins can now change the value of the dice placed under it.

The Cheat
The dice of The Cheat has been changed to be more in-line with its gambling theme and also to give SPADE and HEART effect some needed help.

Old: "Mark" on face-2 and face-3.
New: "Spade" on face-1, 3 and 5. "Heart" on face-2, 4, and 6.


TEXT
Some changes to cats and items text for better clarity.

BUG FIXES
Fixed some wrong sprites in the glossary for unlocks.

The Mirror items may not work as intended depending on the sequence in which you equip items onto cats. This has now been fixed. (NOTE: the order in which you've placed your items will still matter. Item in slot-1 takes effect first and so forth.)

notes.title: HOTFIX - patch v0.0.5
notes.notes:
A short one today.

BUG FIXES

- This patch fixes issues with cats that limit dice placement (such as The Professor and Giant). There were some issues when a passives buffing cat like the Shieldmaiden interacts with them but this should now be fixed.

notes.title: Patch v0.0.4
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

- Increase of $1 in starting gold for Hard and Brutal mode. Their text description indicates that you will start with $5 in Hard mode and $4 in Brutal mode but in actual fact you will be starting with $4 and $3 respectively. This change has been made to reflect what the text actually says.

- In the pause menu, a new "Disable Screenshake" button has been added so you can turn off screenshakes if you want to.


BUG FIXES

- Certain screen resolutions will no longer cut off the edge of your screen when you enter fullscreen. Do note that if your resolution is significantly different from 16:9, entering fullscreen will mean you'll be getting non-pixel perfect sprites.

- Fixed visual bug for Bonus removal tag sprite not aligning with its actual position.

- Fixed misaligned Boon and Bane display bars (from clicking the Boon & Bane button).

These visual bugs only happen on non 16:9 resolutions. Do let me know if you come across any more bugs.

notes.title: HOTFIX - Patch v0.0.3, more bug fixes.
notes.notes:
STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS

- Due to an inability to trigger Steam achievements in v0.0.1, achievements tied to cats and items unlocks will be forever unobtainable if you've already unlocked them in v0.0.1. This has now been fixed by running an achievement check whenever you start up the game.


TEXT FIX

- Added a missing "to" in the Auctioneer's text description.


BUG FIX

- There's an issue with continuing the same run across different computers if you've previously exited the game while you're in the SHOP. This issue has now been fixed. However, if you've ever encountered this error, your latest SHOP save-file "P0_Save_ShopData.sav" would have been corrupted by this bug.

The other save-files are fine. Either start a new run OR use the local files from the computer you were using before encountering this bug. Do not use Seam Cloud's save-files as the corrupted "P0_Save_ShopData.sav" would have been sent onto the Cloud. If your run cannot be recovered then I'm sorry but you'll have to start a new run. The Meta-data save-file is fine so all you will be losing is one run.

- Fixed sprites and text misalignment with non 16:9 resolution. Please do let me know if you still encounter any such issue.

- Fixed visual bug in the glossary. There shouldn't be any lingering images of cats and items now.

- Air Pump-FOUR was given the same ability as Air Pump-THREE, making both of them essentially the same item. This has now been fixed, Air Pump-FOUR correctly gives all dice faces +4 value instead of +3.


KNOWN ISSUES
- Going into fullscreen in certain resolutions will result in the game window extending beyond the screen. I'm still trying to fix this so please give me more time.


That's all for this patch. Thank you for playing and please let me know if you encounter any bugs or issues! You can do so here in the Steam forum or in discord.

Cheers,
Yong

notes.title: Cats & Dice - Early access release date set!
notes.notes:
Release date announcement

Hi all, I am pleased to announce that there is finally a release date for Cats & Dice - May 12th!
Check out the new trailer below: 

[previewyoutube=tYLwHGmG09w;full][/previewyoutube]

Changes to the game

Besides new Cats and items, there has also been a number of changes made to the game that are not reflected in the demo.

One such example is the Boon/Bane system. After looking at feedback and rigorously playtesting it myself, I've made some tweaks to it. A Bane will now only affect you on the round you pick it (much like a "Boss" fight in a sense), whereas a Boon will stick with you throughout the rest of your run. In the previous system where you'd accumulate Banes, it felt too stifling having to constantly plan and play around all the restrictions you'd get. And as you get more Banes it only gets worse.

Of course, to compensate for the fact that a Bane will only affect you for one round it now has much greater impact than before. Each Boon/Bane option will still be randomly paired together so you'd have to weigh the pros and cons of your decision.

Other changes are much smaller in scale, so I won't be listing everything out. Thank you for your continued interest in Cats & Dice, if you'd like to be reminded when this releases, a wishlist and follow would be very much appreciated. Also feel free to join the community on discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144288/c1cf3b28836a5909a25c14680307ad289c966217.gif

Cheers,
Yong

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.1.6
notes.notes:
This is a bug fixing update. It should cover all currently known bugs in the demo.

Bug Fixes
- Reroll cost reduction (ticket) in shop now works correctly and should keep the 1st reroll cost at $0 even after you exit and reload your run midway through a round.

- Restarting the game during certain moments can result in the Cat/item you've just bought reappearing in the shop. This has now been fixed.

- Mousing over cats or items in the shop while they are just popping up will sometimes result in them being matched with the wrong sprites or even render them invisible. This has now been fixed.

- Selling a Cat with item(s) equipped now display the correct amount of $ you'd get (Cats + items). Previously there was a visual bug where you'll still get the right amount but the $ indicated is wrong.

- Gecko Keychain and Sticker can sometimes trigger when other Cats trigger their passives (they should only be triggered when the Cats they are equppied on trigger their passives). This has now been fixed.

- You can get wrong numbers from Shieldmaiden buffing Sunstones if you have multiple Sunstones equipped on a single Cat. This is now fixed.


Thank you for playing. I am working hard on the upcoming Early Access release. Feedback will be appreciated as always so please leave them here on the forum or in discord.

Cheers!
Yong

notes.title: Cats & Dice - demo update and release delay.
notes.notes:
Hi all, this is a little late but let me wish everyone who is reading this a happy 2025!

Release delayed

First of all, a bit of a regrettable news but the release of Cats & Dice will be delayed. I've previously mentioned a January 2025 release, but it looks like that will be a little too tight for me. The game still needs a bit more work to smooth out the rough edges. I am still aiming for a Q1 2025 release though so hopefully it will be just a slight delay.

Final demo update
This will also be the final demo update as the early access release draws near.

Quality of Life
- All sprites for the cats are now in the game (say goodbye to the W-I-P cat for now).

- General polish such as screen transitions.

- You can now take Steam screenshots.

Bug fixes
- The "Sunstone" item is now able to affect other sunstones when equipped on the same cat. Previously a Sunstone will increase the passive number of all abilities/items except for other Sunstones. This means stacking Sunstones onto the same cat now will be way more powerful than before.

- Missing Chinese text for certain items have been fixed.


If you encounter any bugs, do let me know either here or on discord. I will be providing another update once I have an actual release date ready. Until then, thank you for your continued interest in Cats & Dice!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144288/8d2f6aaa7e6ae2140587338e1f8a901759581dd9.png

Cheers,
Yong

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.1.5
notes.notes:
This update to the demo is mostly for bug fixes and certain quality of life features that have been requested.

Bug Fixes
- Using "Bane Removal" ticket on the 'nullify bonus' bane now works correctly without having to exit to the title screen.

- Buying an item by placing it in an already occupied item-slot will deduct its cost twice. This has now been fixed.

- Fixed the game potentially crashing if you're loading a save-file that exited mid-way through a tutorial.


Quality of Life changes
- There is now an option for windowed borderless fullscreen.

- You can now drag and drop dice/cats/items instead of pressing once to pick them up and then pressing again to drop them.

- In addition to the spacebar, you can now press 1-6 with your keyboard while hovering over a dice to send it straight to the position you want. If the dice-slot in that position is already occupied, it will displace the prior dice.

- While holding a dice, dropping it onto another dice in the dice-tray will swap the two dice. Previously this is only possible for dice placed in the dice-slot.

- Added a short-cut button (it's to the left of the dice-slots) where one click will slot in all dice automatically. This is mostly for situations where you are all out of rerolls, or you are going to win/lose regardless and it does not matter where you place the dice.


Polish
- Better presentation of cats/items change when you reroll in the shop.

- Added shadows for cats and they now slowly float around their positions. The floating also serves a informational purpose where if you get the bane that restricts cats from changing positions, they will stop floating and simply stay still like before.


Thank you for playing. Feedback will always be appreciated so please leave them here on the forum or in discord.

Cheers!
Yong

notes.title: Demo Patch v0.1.4
notes.notes:
First of all, hello to all the new players who found this demo because of Nextfest or some other reasons. Welcome!

Thank you to all who have given feedback in one form or another. This patch is mostly about bug fixes, and also to address some of the more common issues I've received feedback on.

Bug fixes:

- The item "Yarn Ball" now accurately reflects its description by giving +1 Reroll every time you score a dice in the same position.

- The Bonus: "Straight" can fail when you have say, 1 2 3 4, and then you place a 6 dice. The gap from 4 to 6 makes the code think the sequence is broken. This has now been fixed.

- When you're in the Shop, depending on how you release/place a cat, it's possible to have 2 cats stacked together in the same position, unable to be separated. This is now fixed.

- While in the Shop, it's possible to place an item you own onto a cat being sold in the shop. This has been fixed. If you try to drop an item onto the dice tray now, you'll just end up selling it.

Quality of life changes:

- The "Cantrip" dice effect has additional description added to better inform players that "Cantrip" ONLY affects the dice effect it's attached to.

- Any Bonus that has been nullified by a Bane now shows up crossed-out when you play its combination.

- Any Bonuses on display will disappear once you press Play. This is because once you press Play, the base Points and Mult you get from bonuses will be locked-in and will not actually increase while scoring even if you get a better bonus.
I know perhaps it doesn't feel good that altering the dice mid-way while scoring results in no change in bonus. But on the flip side, you also don't get penalized if you change a dice value and no longer has a valid bonus. The dice manipulation can still benefit certain Cats like the Triplets or Quadruplets for instance, even if the bonus amount does not change.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144288/f0f5f69fdb1f1167b719283063b5eff5a0cb358c.gif

Thank you for playing. Feedback will always be appreciated so please leave them here on the forum or in discord.

Cheers!
Yong
